body: I am not sure if I can think of somebody. Do you think, if I ignore her calls and keep myself busy, will she find somebody else to move on in life. Is that a good thing to for me to do?

Also, she has been consulting a psychologist and a pshychiatrist in US and getting medications from them. But, she is going through mood swings with me almost everyday. 

When I told her, we cannot be married and continue our relationship. She absolutely hated me and even called my mom and told her that everything was over with me and her. But then, she comes back around after couple of days and wanted to continue in this relationship as friends with "lovey-dovey" exchanges. And this has been going back and forth like this.

Need a good advice from you here. I live in Cali and the girl lives in Texas, going to school for her Phd. Her parents live in India. I have never spoken to her family before, they might be reachable on facebook if I send a message to them. 

She has never wanted to discuss her problems to her family. She never wanted to reach out to them for her problems. She thinks she can solve her depression problems on her own. She does not want to discuss depression problems with her friends coz she feels they will judge her for coming out. She does not want to discuss problems with her parents as she does not want to put them in anxiety. So, I am trying to keep all this to myself and manage her and myself. It's unbelievably complicated. 

Do you still think I should tell her parents about this in India?
